reviews.title: Misleading Subscription Scam
reviews.text:
This app is deceptive and misleading.

I signed up on the website only to view my astrology results. I agreed to pay 1USD to unlock my report, but I never signed up for a Premium subscription. At no point was it clearly explained that this $1 payment would automatically enroll me in a recurring membership.

Without my explicit knowledge or consent, I was later charged $49for a Premium subscription that I never intended to purchase.

This is an unacceptable and misleading billing practice. Customers should never be automatically enrolled in a recurring subscription without clear and transparent disclosure.

I have requested a full refund. If this issue is not resolved immediately, I will dispute the charge with my bank/payment provider and report these deceptive practices to the appropriate consumer protection authorities.

I strongly advise everyone to stay away from this app.
reviews.reply:
Hi. We hear your extreme frustration and are truly sorry. Experiencing hidden $49 charges after a $1 payment is totally unacceptable. We take your concerns seriously and want to sort out your refund immediately.
Please reach out to support-appstore@asknebula.com.
With gratitude,
Nebula 🔮
